name: Air Force One
description: Follow Air Force One, a tracked concept, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: DOJ admits legal errors, drops subpoenas of New York Times journalists
changes.summary: A judge criticized the Justice Department for legal errors that ultimately led the agency to withdraw its subpoenas of two New York Times journalists who wrote a story about security concerns on President Trump's Qatari-gifted Air Force One. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman has the latest.

changes.title: DOJ to withdraw subpoenas for New York Times reporters over Air Force One story
changes.summary: The New York Times moved to block subpoenas issued by the Justice Department for grand jury testimony and phone records from its reporters.

changes.title: New Air Force One going out of commission to get safety upgrades
changes.summary: The new Air Force One is going out of commission to receive safety upgrades. What needs to be done and was it safe for President Trump to fly the plane to Turkey earlier this month?

changes.title: Trump Administration Sought Phone Records of Times Journalists and Their Relatives
changes.summary: The government is aggressively seeking the confidential sources of Times reporters who wrote about the president’s new Air Force One. The Times has asked a judge to quash the subpoenas.

changes.title: DOJ sought phone records of journalists and relatives in effort to unmask sources of Air Force One security report
changes.summary: A court document says the Trump administration sought New York Times journalists' phone records and even those of some of their relatives in an attempt to unmask the confidential sources of reporters who wrote about Trump's Qatari-gifted Air Force One jet.

changes.title: White House Says New Air Force One Will Be Out of Service for a Month for ‘Upgrades’
changes.summary: The White House press secretary said the unspecified “enhancements” would take place this fall. The plane has been under scrutiny over whether it has sufficient defensive capabilities.

changes.title: Trump to keep using old Air Force One while new plane gets security upgrades
changes.summary: The new Air Force One "has a lot of capability, but as I understand it, in about a month or so, they're going to send it to have it be maxed out," President Trump said Sunday.
